title: Benjamin Franklin and the Whistle
summary: Do not give too much for the whistle; discern what is truly valuable in life.
full_text:
Historical Exchange featuring Benjamin Franklin.

"Do not give too much for the whistle; discern what is truly valuable in life."

This celebrated moment in parliamentary and diplomatic history illustrates the timeless power of intellect, courage, and rhetorical brilliance.
